aboutCopy.heading: About us
aboutCopy.paragraph: At Saving Grace Bible Church, we aim to exalt the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and magnify the truths of Scripture in West Meadows, Victoria. We stand as a steadfast lighthouse of Christ-centered reformed dispensationalist theology, embracing the principles of Calvinism and the literal future of Bible prophecies with unwavering devotion.
aboutCopy.quote: “I will not offer to the Lord my God sacrifices that have cost me nothing.”

copy.churchNotice: Church Notice: No tuesday night study during the school holiday.

pillars.title: History
pillars.text: Discover how God has led our church family from small beginnings to where we are today.

pillars.title: Lord’s Day
pillars.text: Each Sunday we gather to worship Christ and hear His Word faithfully preached — the heart of our life together.

pillars.title: Our Faith
pillars.text: We hold fast to the truths of Scripture — God’s sovereignty, salvation by grace, and the hope of Christ’s return.

pillars.title: The Gospel
pillars.text: The good news is simple yet profound: though we are sinners, Christ died and rose again to bring us forgiveness and new life.

morning.title: Sunday Morning 10:30am (Formal)
morning.text: Every Sunday morning we meet for our main service, a time of reverent worship and faithful preaching from God’s Word.

evening.title: Sunday Evening 5:30pm (Informal)
evening.text: In the evenings we meet in a relaxed setting to reflect on the morning’s sermon, ask questions, and talk about how God’s Word applies in practice.

welcomeCopy.heading: Welcome to Saving Grace Bible Church
welcomeCopy.paragraph: a community united in love with a singular aim: to glorify God. Our cornerstone is Christ-centered worship, the pinnacle of which is found in the sermon message. Every Sunday from 10:30 am, we gather as a diverse family, different ages, backgrounds, and ethnicities—unified through the Gospel of Jesus Christ.
